name: cladding
description: Reference implementation of the Ironclad standard — multi-agent dev harness for OpenAI Codex CLI / IDE / cloud. Exposes spec validation, drift detection, the Iron Law stage runner, and 5 agent personas as Codex skills + an auto-launched MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent dev harness — spec, drift, and 13 Iron Law stages.
interface.longDescription: Cladding is the reference implementation of the Ironclad standard, a graded falsifiable consistency standard for AI-coding harnesses. Install this plugin to get cladding's six skills (sync, check, panel, drive, init, serve), five persona prompts (orchestrator, librarian, reviewer, observability, specialists), and an auto-launched MCP server that exposes spec / drift / events / personas to Codex.
